svg.title: save_best_only: False vs True
svg.desc: Validation accuracy over 9 epochs: it rises to 75% and 80%, then goes up and down around the best result. With save_best_only=False the model is saved after every epoch, 9 files. With save_best_only=True, monitor='val_accuracy' and mode='max', it is saved only when it improves over the previous best result: 75%, 80%, 81% and 83%, so 4 files; the other epochs are skipped.

g.text: save only when it's an improvement over the previous best result
